summary: Lucas GC Ltd filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $20 million in Class A ordinary shares via Maxim Group LLC as agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. No special-situation terms such as a fixed price, premium, or tender mechanics are present. The agent receives 3% commission and uses commercially reasonable efforts. The shares trade on Nasdaq under LGCL. No watch items or risk-arb angle apply.
